articles.title: Anthropic opens its books for Wall Street, showing record revenue and mounting obligations
articles.description: Anthropic is the first major AI lab to file an S-1 with the SEC, planning to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT." The numbers are strong, with $11.6 billion in quarterly revenue, a first-ever operating profit, and existing customers spending nine times more year over year. But the company also carries roughly $800 billion in long-term compute commitments. The article Anthropic opens its books for Wall Street, showing record revenue and mounting obligations appeared first on The Decoder.

articles.title: Orchestrating SageMaker AI endpoint auto scaling with AWS CDK
articles.description: Updating a SageMaker AI endpoint that has Application Auto Scaling registered makes AWS CloudFormation and AWS CDK deployments fail. This post shows how to build a reusable AWS CDK construct with CloudFormation custom resources that deregisters and re-registers auto scaling automatically, so you can update the endpoint and its scaling in a single deployment.
articles.author: Lauren Eterno
articles.content: Updating a SageMaker AI endpoint that has Application Auto Scaling registered makes AWS CloudFormation and AWS CDK deployments fail.
